intervals.label: research proposal approved by the PSI research committee
intervals.note: Month precision: the item is dated 16. January 2013 and its text says the proposal was presented "on January 2013". Left open-ended because the next dated status (construction) has only a lower-bound start; the state derives to construction from that start on.
intervals.quote: The international research committee for particle physics at the ring cyclotron under the chairmanship of Dr. Cyrus Hoffman acknowledged the scientific case and approved the proposal.

intervals.label: Phase I construction
intervals.note: Start is a lower bound, not a stated "construction began" date: the earliest dated source found that calls Phase I "under construction" is the December 2018 European-Strategy submission (arXiv:1812.06540v1, 16 Dec 2018), whose own Mu3e section says "Construction of the Mu3e Phase-I experiment will begin in 2019" (a plan). PSI's news list shows a construction meeting in Wengen on 01.03.2019 and the solenoid arriving on 29.07.2020. Phase I was still described as "currently under construction" in the June 2026 abstract (Phi-Psi 2026) and on 16.09.2026 the fourth pixel layer was still to follow for the next beam time, so the interval stays open. Status checked 2026-10-25: the newest PSI news item is dated 24.09.2026 (detector craned into the PiE5 magnet); no fetched source reports the start of the two-month beam time planned for October-November 2026, so the current state is recorded as construction and not as active.
intervals.quote: The first phase of the Mu3e experiment is under construction at PSI

intervals.label: first integration run (parts of the detector in the magnet, beam on target)
intervals.locator: psi.ch/en/mu3e/mu3e, entry labelled "May/June 2021", "First Mu3e Integration Run"
intervals.note: A run recorded as an annotation of the construction phase (kind run). The collaboration news item is dated 26.06.2021.
intervals.quote: During an extensive campaign at PSI, the Mu3e collaboration for the first time operated parts of the detector inside the experiment magnet and with muon beam stopping on a target in the center of the experiment.

intervals.label: cosmic run with a vertex-detector prototype and a fibre ribbon
intervals.locator: psi.ch/en/mu3e/mu3e, entry labelled "May/June 2022", "Cosmic Run at PSI"
intervals.note: Run annotation (kind run); the collaboration news item is dated 28.06.2022.
intervals.quote: This setup was used to develop commissioning and tuning procedures for the sensors, advance DAQ integration, develop user interfaces, check timing and finally to detect cosmic ray muons passing through the set-up.

intervals.label: June 2025 beam time: vertex, fibre and tile modules together in beam

intervals.note: Run annotation (kind run). Three weeks of muon beam in June 2025 with the vertex pixel detector, scintillating fibre and scintillating tile modules operated together for the first time.
intervals.quote: In preparation for Phase I data-taking, a crucial commissioning campaign took place in June 2025

intervals.label: 2026 installation of the central detector station
intervals.locator: psi.ch/en/mu3e/news: 10.07.2026 vertex detector, 07.08.2026 scintillating fibre detector, 21.08.2026 scintillating tile detector, 16.09.2026 layer 3, 24.09.2026 craned into the PiE5 area
intervals.note: Phase annotation (kind phase). End: Today Mu3e was craned from the staging setup to the PiE5 area, where the experiment was inserted into the Mu3e magnet. (24.09.2026), after which "all cables now have to be re-connected and qualified and then we can begin full detector operation".
intervals.quote: Mu3e has installed the vertex detector for the 2026 beamtime, marking an important milestone in the detector assembly.

intervals.label: pixel-tracker installation (third layer)
intervals.note: Phase annotation (kind phase). Previously recorded as the only construction interval at month precision (2026-09); the source gives the day. The fourth layer "will follow for the next beam time" and is replaced for now by a helium-guiding foil.
intervals.quote: The third layer of the Mu3e pixel detector was sucessfully installed.

intervals.label: two-month beam time (planned)
intervals.note: A schedule, not a report of an event (kind run, planned). As of 2026-10-25 no fetched source says the beam time has begun. RE-CHECK 2026-10-25: the PSI Mu3e news page (https://www.psi.ch/en/mu3e/news) lists as its newest item 24.09.2026 ("Today Mu3e was craned from the staging setup to the PiE5 area, where the experiment was inserted into the Mu3e magnet."); it has nothing on the start of the October-November beam time, and the PSI secondary-beam-line schedule page links only schedules from 2013 to 2020, so the start is not confirmed and the interval stays planned.
intervals.quote: The layer three installation is the last big installation before our two month beam time in October and November.

intervals.label: first physics run (planned)
intervals.note: Schedule slip, all planned values: European-Strategy submission of Dec 2018 expected a first commissioning run in 2020 (arXiv:1812.06540); the Jan 2025 status paper "Later on, the first physics data-taking is estimated for 2026" (arXiv:2501.14667, section 3); the Mar 2025 review expects a first physics data run in 2026 and, "After the long shutdown of the HIPA accelerator in 2027 and 2028, data-taking will resume at the end of 2028" (arXiv:2503.22461, section 2.3); the June 2026 abstract says the physics run is anticipated in 2027. How a 2027 run fits the HIPA shutdown is not stated in any fetched source dated after March 2025.
intervals.quote: an outlook on the 2026 campaign leading towards the physics run, anticipated in 2027

name: Mu3e
notes: No physics results exist yet; the detector is still being assembled and commissioned (most recent dated evidence: the experiment was craned into the PiE5 magnet on 2026-09-24; a two-month beam time was planned for October-November 2026). Stated explicitly rather than left to silence.

physics_goals.quote: We plan an eXperiment to search for the lepton flavour violating decay of the muon to three electrons with a branching ratio sensitivity of 10^{-16}
physics_goals.value: Search for the lepton-flavor-violating decay of a positive muon into two positrons and one electron (μ⁺ → e⁺e⁺e⁻) with a branching-ratio sensitivity of 10⁻¹⁶

summary.plain: An experiment being built at the Paul Scherrer Institute in Switzerland to look for a muon splitting into three lighter particles (two positrons and an electron), which the Standard Model says essentially never happens. It is still under construction.
summary.technical: Mu3e (PSI, on the HiMB/piE5 beamline fed by accelerator:psi-hipa, referenced but owned by the 'facilities' workstream): searches for μ⁺ → e⁺e⁺e⁻ using an ultra-thin HV-MAPS silicon pixel tracker plus scintillating fibre and tile timing detectors, targeting a branching-ratio sensitivity of 10⁻¹⁶. As of the most recently fetched official update (2026-09-24), the experiment had been craned into the PiE5 magnet after the third pixel layer was installed (2026-09-16); the detector remains under construction, a beam time was planned for October-November 2026, and no physics result has been produced yet.

unique_capabilities.quote: To this aim, we use innovative high-voltage monolithic active pixel sensors (HV-MAPS)
unique_capabilities.value: Uses innovative high-voltage monolithic active pixel sensors (HV-MAPS) for an ultra-thin, high-rate silicon pixel tracker combined with scintillating-fibre and -tile timing detectors
